slides: Never send an agency a mood board
A mood board shows what you like.
It says nothing about who you sell to.
The agency fills the gap with its own taste,
and you pay for a stranger’s guesses.
The first round comes back beautiful,
Then you spend three rounds explaining a customer
Write one page before any pictures.
Who buys, what they do today, and why they would switch.
List three brands your buyer already trusts.
Say what you would borrow from each.
A founder in a Dubai café is on her fourth hour of Pinterest,
while her customers’ reviews sit unread in another tab.
I help founders brief agencies so the first round lands.
DM me “BRIEF” and I’ll review your brief page and mark where an agency would have to guess.
